<svg viewBox="0 0 1200 700" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
    <style>
        .wall-outer { fill: #fcfcfd; stroke: #1e293b; stroke-width: 4; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-linecap: round; }
        .wall-major { fill: none; stroke: #334155; stroke-width: 2.8; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-linecap: square; }
        .wall-inner { fill: none; stroke: #64748b; stroke-width: 1.6; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-linecap: square; }
        .door-leaf { fill: none; stroke: #334155; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linecap: round; }
        .door-swing { fill: none; stroke: #94a3b8; stroke-width: 1.1; stroke-dasharray: 2.5,2.5; }
        .fixture { fill: #f1f5f9; stroke: #cbd5e1; stroke-width: 1; }
        .fixture-dash { fill: none; stroke: #94a3b8; stroke-width: 1; stroke-dasharray: 3,3; }
        .crane-rail { fill: none; stroke: #f59e0b; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-dasharray: 6,4; }
        .safety-fence { fill: none; stroke: #ef4444; stroke-width: 1.4; stroke-dasharray: 4,3; }
        .safety-walkway { fill: none; stroke: #e2e8f0; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-dasharray: 4,4; }
        .room-label { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 9.5px; fill: #475569; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.5px; text-transform: uppercase; user-select: none; }
    </style>

    <!-- Outer Perimeter (1100 x 600) -->
    <rect x="50" y="50" width="1100" height="600" class="wall-outer" />

    <!-- ==================== WEST BLOCK: TECH LABS & IT ==================== -->
    <line x1="300" y1="50" x2="300" y2="230" class="wall-major" />
    <line x1="300" y1="230" x2="300" y2="255" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 300,230 A 25,25 0 0,0 275,255" class="door-swing" />
    <line x1="300" y1="290" x2="300" y2="265" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 300,290 A 25,25 0 0,1 275,265" class="door-swing" />
    <line x1="300" y1="290" x2="300" y2="650" class="wall-major" />

    <!-- MDF Server Room: x: 50..230, y: 50..220 (rack at 140, 140) -->
    <line x1="230" y1="50" x2="230" y2="220" class="wall-major" />
    <line x1="50" y1="220" x2="180" y2="220" class="wall-major" />
    <line x1="180" y1="220" x2="180" y2="190" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 210,220 A 30,30 0 0,0 180,190" class="door-swing" />
    <line x1="210" y1="220" x2="230" y2="220" class="wall-major" />
    <text x="65" y="75" class="room-label">MDF SERVER ROOM</text>

    <line x1="230" y1="160" x2="300" y2="160" class="wall-inner" />
    <text x="240" y="75" class="room-label" style="font-size: 8px;">FIBER</text>

    <!-- Shift Supervisor: x: 50..230, y: 220..310 -->
    <line x1="50" y1="310" x2="230" y2="310" class="wall-inner" />
    <line x1="230" y1="240" x2="205" y2="240" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 230,270 A 30,30 0 0,1 205,240" class="door-swing" />
    <text x="65" y="245" class="room-label" style="font-size: 8.5px;">SUPERVISOR</text>

    <!-- Testing Lab: x: 50..230, y: 310..540 (rack at 140, 450) -->
    <line x1="50" y1="540" x2="300" y2="540" class="wall-inner" />
    <line x1="230" y1="310" x2="230" y2="540" class="wall-major" />
    <text x="65" y="335" class="room-label">TESTING LAB</text>
    <rect x="65" y="370" width="50" height="35" class="fixture" />

    <!-- Airlock: x: 230..300, y: 360..460 -->
    <line x1="230" y1="360" x2="300" y2="360" class="wall-inner" />
    <line x1="230" y1="460" x2="300" y2="460" class="wall-inner" />
    <line x1="230" y1="405" x2="210" y2="405" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 230,375 A 30,30 0 0,0 210,405" class="door-swing" />
    <line x1="230" y1="485" x2="210" y2="485" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 230,515 A 30,30 0 0,1 210,485" class="door-swing" />
    <text x="240" y="380" class="room-label" style="font-size: 7.5px;">AIRLOCK</text>

    <!-- Staff Lockers & WC -->
    <line x1="170" y1="540" x2="170" y2="650" class="wall-inner" />
    <text x="65" y="565" class="room-label" style="font-size: 8px;">LOCKERS</text>
    <line x1="240" y1="540" x2="240" y2="650" class="wall-inner" />
    <text x="180" y="565" class="room-label" style="font-size: 8px;">WC 1</text>
    <text x="250" y="565" class="room-label" style="font-size: 8px;">WC 2</text>

    <!-- ==================== CENTER BLOCK: PRODUCTION ==================== -->
    <!-- CNC Workshop (rack at 575, 200) -->
    <text x="325" y="75" class="room-label">CNC WORKSHOP</text>
    <line x1="330" y1="105" x2="850" y2="105" class="crane-rail" />
    <line x1="330" y1="315" x2="850" y2="315" class="crane-rail" />

    <rect x="340" y="130" width="75" height="50" class="fixture" />
    <rect x="450" y="130" width="85" height="50" class="fixture" />
    <rect x="670" y="130" width="75" height="50" class="fixture" />
    <rect x="770" y="130" width="75" height="50" class="fixture" />

    <line x1="300" y1="340" x2="880" y2="340" class="safety-walkway" />
    <line x1="300" y1="370" x2="880" y2="370" class="safety-walkway" />

    <!-- Robotics Bay (rack at 575, 500) -->
    <text x="325" y="395" class="room-label">ROBOTICS BAY</text>
    <rect x="340" y="440" width="160" height="120" class="safety-fence" />
    <circle cx="420" cy="500" r="22" class="fixture" />
    <rect x="670" y="440" width="160" height="120" class="safety-fence" />
    <circle cx="750" cy="500" r="22" class="fixture" />

    <!-- ==================== EAST BLOCK: MAINTENANCE & UTILITIES ==================== -->
    <line x1="880" y1="50" x2="880" y2="200" class="wall-major" />
    <line x1="880" y1="200" x2="880" y2="260" class="fixture-dash" stroke-width="2" />
    <line x1="880" y1="260" x2="880" y2="440" class="wall-major" />
    <line x1="880" y1="440" x2="880" y2="500" class="fixture-dash" stroke-width="2" />
    <line x1="880" y1="500" x2="880" y2="650" class="wall-major" />

    <line x1="880" y1="180" x2="1150" y2="180" class="wall-major" />
    <rect x="910" y="80" width="60" height="40" class="fixture" />
    <rect x="990" y="80" width="60" height="40" class="fixture" />
    <text x="910" y="145" class="room-label" style="font-size: 8.5px;">COMPRESSORS</text>

    <!-- Maintenance Shop (rack at 1010, 350) -->
    <text x="910" y="215" class="room-label">MAINTENANCE</text>
    <rect x="910" y="250" width="70" height="50" class="fixture-dash" />
    <rect x="1070" y="250" width="60" height="25" class="fixture" />
    <rect x="1070" y="290" width="60" height="25" class="fixture" />
    <rect x="1070" y="390" width="60" height="25" class="fixture" />
    <rect x="1070" y="430" width="60" height="25" class="fixture" />

    <line x1="880" y1="490" x2="1150" y2="490" class="wall-major" />
    <rect x="910" y="520" width="110" height="30" class="fixture" />
    <rect x="910" y="565" width="110" height="30" class="fixture" />
    <text x="910" y="618" class="room-label" style="font-size: 8.5px;">SWITCHGEAR</text>
</svg>
